# CheckerLeak.com — Complete Technical Reference & Knowledge Base
Version: 2.2.2 | Architecture: Carrier-Grade Low-Latency REST API | Protocols: HTTP/2, TLS 1.3

## 1. System Overview
CheckerLeak.com is a carrier-grade contact intelligence and identity footprint verification engine designed for high-volume growth teams, lead generation agencies, Web3 brokers, and enterprise risk systems. It verifies phone numbers, email addresses, and digital identities across 240+ countries and territories without incurring SMS delivery fees or alerting the target recipient.

### Core Architecture Principles:
- **Zero-Retention (Privacy-First)**: CheckerLeak never persists raw phone numbers or query payloads. All memory buffers are wiped immediately after the verification pipeline returns.
- **Cascading Execution**: Local offline ITU E.164 normalization runs first (sub-millisecond), screening out invalid prefixes before invoking higher-level telecom HLR or OTT messaging probes. This reduces API spend by up to 90%.
- **Enterprise Privacy & Zero-Retention**: All memory buffers are wiped immediately after the verification pipeline returns with zero logging of sensitive customer contacts.
- **Automated Pay-as-you-go Credit Activation**: Customers can fund balance accounts with instant automated credit allocation without recurring monthly locks.

### Category 5: Fraud, Risk & Telecom HLR (8 Engines)
79. **Phone Number Validation**: ITU E.164 normalization, country prefix, valid national significant number.
80. **Number Active Checker**: Live SS7 / Diameter network interrogation confirming phone is currently powered on and attached to base station.
81. **High-value Users Checker**: Heuristic scoring evaluating multi-platform saturation, carrier tier, and digital footprint.
82. **Carrier Detection**: Identifies original and ported Mobile Network Operator (MNO/MVNO).
83. **Advanced US Carrier Checker**: Identifies US Tier-1 telcos (Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile) vs MVNOs (Mint, Cricket, Boost).
84. **Sideline Checker**: Detects virtual secondary numbers issued by Sideline / Pinger.
85. **SIM Swap & Port-Out Risk**: Identifies recent IMSI changes and carrier porting within 30-90 days to prevent account takeover (ATO).
86. **Disposable & Burner Number Risk**: Flags temporary online SMS receive numbers, VoIP burners, and free SMS gateways.

## 3. REST API Specifications

### Base URL:
`https://checkerleak.com/v1` (Local dev: `http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1`)

### Authentication:
Pass standard Bearer token in the `Authorization` HTTP header:
`Authorization: Bearer pk_live_your_api_key_here`

### Core Endpoints:
1. `POST /v1/verify/single` — Real-time cascading verification for a single contact.
2. `POST /v1/verify/batch` — High-speed parallel list verification.
3. `POST /v1/verify/service` — Targeted probe for any single engine from the 102 catalog.
4. `POST /v1/batch/upload-file` — File upload supporting CSV and TXT formats up to 50,000 numbers per batch.
5. `GET /v1/geo/detect` — Returns client IP, ISO country code, localized telecom carriers, and recommended engines.
6. `GET /v1/billing/plans` — Returns pricing tiers and credit packs.

## 4. Competitive Benchmarks
| Benchmark Metric | CheckerLeak.com | NumberChecker.AI | Twilio Lookup v2 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Catalog Depth** | 102 Engines | ~18 Engines | Telecom Only (Carrier & Line Type) |
| **Apple Blue-Bubble** | Yes (Native IDS) | No | No |
| **Crypto Exchanges** | 6 Exchanges (Binance, OKX, etc.) | None | None |
| **Neobanks / Fintech** | Revolut, Wise, PayPal, CashApp | Partial | None |
| **Speed (Single Check)** | < 150ms | 1200ms - 2500ms | 350ms - 500ms |
| **Payment Anonymity** | 100% Crypto (Zero KYC) | Mandatory Stripe Card | Enterprise Agreement / Invoice |
| **Data Retention** | 0 Days (In-memory only) | Undisclosed | 30+ Days |
